summary: No elevation surface: no RunAs, Start-Process, or ShellExecute anywhere (source-asserted by tests); user-scope winget flags pinned; winget identity API-derived, never PATH-trusted (hijack test); APPEXECLINK accepted by lexists-without-resolve only, ordinary symlinks rejected; env vars used for PATH-candidate discovery only with the trust-boundary distinction documented in 0040; installer-owned UAC prompts are the OS's own, never harness-built (0040).
residual_risks: A package installer may self-elevate with its own OS prompt; declining yields a named red row, per 0040.
